description: fix-slugify — authored through the bareloop panel (green, js)
goal: npm test exits 0 with every test in test/slug.test.js passing, proving slugify lowercases, drops punctuation, collapses repeated spaces, and trims the ends.

notes: Only one check was confirmed in the plan — `npm test` exits 0 with a green, zero-failure suite — so that is the whole work set: suite-green-exit (command-exit, exit 0) plus suite-green-no-failures (the fail-count assertion of the same suite). No other work stage was added.

No typecheck stage is composed: the facts object states there is no tsconfig/jsconfig, no TypeScript dependency, no `typecheck`/`lint`/`check` script and no `@ts-check` pragma anywhere, so any typecheck command would be invented. The confirmed plan did not ask for one either.

No tests-kept stage is composed: the plan asks only for exit 0 / zero failures, and a floor on executed tests is not part of the confirmed checks. (The runner does print `# tests N`, so it could be measured, but the genre template restricts tests-kept to checks the plan actually asked for.)

The suite invokes the package's own script semantics via the Node binary itself (`node --test`, exactly the `test` script in package.json), run from the repo root as package.json's script specifies — no bare or third-party runner, and nothing installed, since the repo has no dependencies.

The fail-count stage is scoped to the only two populations this repository's suite covers, `src/` (the implementation files) and `test/` (the test files); the TAP summary line `# fail N` names no path, so the scope filter cannot attribute it to a prefix — it is a suite-wide figure for exactly those two trees, which is the population being counted. This produced a benign 'no path could be judged, kept' notice in the seed read, not an instrument stop.

The piped TAP shape (`# tests N`, `# pass N`, `# fail N`) is the shape read here; the facts object notes Node prints the human spec reporter on a TTY and that no reporter is configured in the repo, so all patterns use the genre's measured piped spellings.

The seed read confirms this close discriminates: at the untouched seed, changed-from-seed is red (nothing changed), suite-green-exit is red (exit 1), suite-green-no-failures reads 3 against a baseline of 0, and only the always-on no-suppressions guard is green — i.e. the suite is not green at the start, matching the facts object's 1 pass / 3 fail expectation for the stub.

Not expressible mechanically and therefore left out: the interview's request that only files under src/ be edited and that the tests not be changed is enforced by the always-on write fence (`src/**`) rather than restated as a stage here; no stage can assert 'these tests still mean what they meant', so no such stage was approximated.
